name: MMLU-Pro
datasetVersion: Over 12,000 questions across 14 domains, ten answer choices
methodologyNotes: Multiple-choice knowledge and reasoning benchmark that extends MMLU to ten answer choices and expects chain-of-thought answering. Scores are exact-match accuracy and are only comparable across models measured under the same shot count, prompt, and harness.

name: GPQA Diamond
methodologyNotes: Graduate-level, Google-proof science question answering. Diamond is the benchmark's highest-quality expert-validated subset. Scores are accuracy and are only comparable across models measured under the same subset, shot count, and harness.

name: LiveCodeBench
methodologyNotes: Contamination-free code-generation benchmark that collects new competitive-programming problems over time, so a result is only comparable to others measured over the same problem-release window. Scores are pass@1.

name: MMMU
methodologyNotes: College-level multi-discipline multimodal understanding across image-and-text questions. Scores are accuracy and are only comparable across models measured under the same shot count and harness.
